idea-plugin.name: ZK Framework Variables Binding
idea-plugin.description:
Full ZK Framework MVVM binding support for IntelliJ IDEA

Enhances the development experience for ZK Framework projects by bridging .zul files and Java ViewModels.

Features:

  • Automatic Usage Detection: Getters, setters, and variables referenced in .zul files are recognised as "used" — no false "No usages" warnings.
  • Bidirectional Navigation: Ctrl+Click on a binding expression in a .zul file jumps to the corresponding Java method or field.
  • Gutter Icons: Gutter markers on Java methods show where they are used in .zul files.
  • Find Usages: Finds all usages of a method, including ZK binding expressions in .zul files.
  • Full Binding Support: @bind, @load, @save, @init, @command, and all other ZK MVVM binding annotations.
  • Safe Refactoring: Renaming a Java method updates all matching binding references in .zul files automatically.
  • Code Completion: Typing @bind(vm. lists the ViewModel properties (including inherited and nested ones); @command(' lists available commands.
  • Java in <zscript>: Full Java language support (completion, highlighting, navigation) inside <zscript> blocks in .zul files.

Supported binding patterns:

  • @bind(vm.propertyName)
  • @load(vm.propertyName)
  • @save(vm.propertyName)
  • @init(vm.propertyName)
  • @command('methodName')
  • All other ZK MVVM binding patterns
idea-plugin.change-notes:
Version 1.1.3

  • New: Code completion inside binding expressions — type @bind(vm. to see ViewModel properties (including nested paths like vm.person.), or @command(' to see commands.
  • New: Quick fixes on unresolved bindings — Alt+Enter on a red vm.foo creates the property (field + getter + setter), on a red command creates the @Command method.
  • New: Nested paths and expressions are fully supported: @load(vm.address.city), @load(vm.count gt 0 ? vm.name : '-') — every segment navigates, renames and counts as a usage.
  • New: Form binding — fx. properties resolve to the form's backing bean, and before='save' / after= resolve to commands.
  • Fix: Commands with parameters (@command('save', item=each)) are now recognised.
  • Fix: Clicking the gutter icon on a Java method navigates to its .zul usages again.
  • Compatibility with IntelliJ IDEA 2026.3.
  • Build migrated to IntelliJ Platform Gradle Plugin 2.x.

Version 1.1.2

  • New: Java language injection inside <zscript> blocks — full code completion, syntax highlighting, and navigation available.
  • Fix: Import resolution logic reworked — methods and variables used in .zul files no longer show a spurious "No usages" tag in the IDE.

Version 1.0.0

  • Initial release.
  • Automatic usage detection for getters and setters referenced in .zul bindings.
  • Full Java ↔ ZUL navigation.
  • Support for all ZK binding types.
  • Gutter icons indicating .zul usages.
